Happy 3rd Month for us, My Pookiepie ❤️

Three months with you, and you still give me butterflies in the simplest ways. I still smile whenever your name appears on my phone, and I still look forward to every conversation, every laugh, and every little moment we share. You are one of the best things that has ever happened to me, baby, and I'm so grateful that life brought me to you

You're my first in so many ways, and you're the one I hope will be my last. I know we still have so much to learn about each other, but I want to keep growing with you, choosing you, and loving you through the easy days and the difficult ones. Thank you for every day you've spent with me, for making ordinary moments special, and for being someone who brings so much happiness into my life

Three months down, and I still want more days, more memories, and more reasons to fall in love with you. If I could choose all over again, I'd still choose you, pookiepie. I'm so lucky to have you, and I hope I get to celebrate many more monthsaries with you. I love you so much, my favorite person. Here's to us and everything that's still ahead of us 🤍

The Things I Cherish With You

To My Lovely Miza, My Pookiepie ❤️

My lovely Miza, I'm so deeply in love with you that sometimes, you don't even realize how much your words can affect me. You can make me smile so easily, but you can also make me sad just as fast, especially when you ragebait me about your love for me. I know you're joking, baby, and I know you don't always mean the things you say, but sometimes, those jokes get to me more than I let on

Lately, I've been feeling a little disconnected from you, and I miss feeling close to you the way I used to. Sometimes, I get confused by the mixed signals when you tease me about your feelings and then tell me it's only a joke. I'm not asking you to stop being playful with me, pookie. I just hope you understand that because I love you this much, those little things can affect me more than you'd expect.

Even so, baby, I want you to know that my love for you isn't something I'm willing to give up just because things feel uncertain sometimes. Even if you get bored of me someday, I'll still be grateful for every moment you've given me. But if there's one thing I wish for, it's that we keep choosing each other. Can't it just be us, pookie? Just you and me, growing together, learning each other, and making more memories for as long as life allows us to.

I don't need us to be perfect. I just want us to be honest with each other, to feel secure in what we have, and to never make each other question whether we're still choosing one another. I want to keep being the person you can come to find and talk after a tiring day, the one who listens to your stories, laughs at your nonsense, and stays beside you when things get difficult

I love you, Miza. More than I can sometimes put into words. And if I could ask for one thing, it would be more time with you, more chances to love you better, and more days where we get to remind each other that we're still here, still trying, and still choosing us. I don't know everything the future holds, but I know that right now, you're the person I want to keep building something beautiful with. I hope it's you and me for a long, long time, my pookiepie🤍

Happy 3rd Anniversary

Thank you for choosing me, every single day.
